# Complete recorded Sum32 admission

## State and scope

This directory is a source-only delivery. No Python process, AST/import check,
native image, Torch, compiler, emission, sealing, or recorded replay has been
executed by its author. A successful source readback is not semantic admission.

The current actual build is source03:

- Runtime: be841bf3468b4ce6ce66daead602d540839dadb1f8ceca2fd3b5940ff2e6d545.
- ELF: cff287705bc2c9cfc9eb53f0c3f68b287c30e6e93c2b44cfe8954047fc386234.

- Native comparison source package: f13a204f5071c07b34ab35ee1b4a6dc90163137b0762fb57bd8c34abb0c8b277.
- Separate actual build binding: 5a04cc0f9d2fabe86a321bcb514ce4d6ce3f130dfdb63581fb8e3d31d6fde1f6.

The immutable Torch reference is c14e4b18f657429ad5dac5498c3abcae303b6a7e7550db7d15a3c9179bdcd728,
with all 32 cases and 626 events. Python retains every original uint64 literal;
no JSON number is converted through a JavaScript number in the admission.

The original source02 execution remains 21 PASS / 11 FAIL, with 618 / 626 events
completed. Its complete root report and historical raw archive pins remain in
profile.json. This reader does not reclassify or rerun that history. The new
source03 execution must supply its own actual report and complete raw record.

## Two separate pure steps

1. seal_raw.py preserves a completed native run, every directory and file,
   the full original input ledger, and original execution receipts. It emits
   an archive, a complete member manifest, a bounded 32-case summary, and an
   evidence binding. Its success is PASS_CUSTODY_ONLY. The original native
   status can still be FAIL and is retained without relabelling.

2. admit_recorded_sum32.py replays the original Case against the original
   request, response, and owner bytes. A final PASS requires all 32 original
   cases, all 626 events, the complete original report, and every byte/mode
   member obligation to match. It never creates a Tensor process.

The root operator owns the actual invocations. The supplied request templates
are NOT_SUBMITTED and deliberately contain PENDING values. Do not edit a frozen
template. Write a separate actual plan/request after reviewing the completed
native report and original operator receipts.

## Reused predicates and the four transport edits

source-reuse.json and recorded-wire-inverse.json record the exact source
relationship. The complete original R4 pure reader is included as provenance.
Its RecordedSession has only four explicit edits: 115/116/117 public results,
complete Sum EOF/owner-journal fields, complete endpoint-backed owner reads,
and full journal consumption at EOF. The whole block reverses to the original.

Four pure byte helpers are copied verbatim. The complete source03 SumCase is
27544 bytes with SHA191bdc7d1f69679912345ddca8efcf4e06bc1f29659ec7d65c1b349a17b68a54,
identical to source02. There are no Case method overrides. Its original check,
tensor, identity, Saved, gradient, snapshot, weak, exception, RNG, and partial
backward comparisons all run from the original frozen source.

The original Native.__init__ exchange wrapper is also unchanged. Only three
runtime construction boundaries are redirected:

- Session construction selects RecordedSession.
- capture_owner reads the exported complete endpoint and returns its actual
  bytes together with the independently decoded snapshot and summary.
- finish verifies the observed original exit/dual EOF/raw streams and closes
  the new pure journal. It does not wait on, signal, or start a process.

Every regenerated request must equal the original request body byte-for-byte.
Only the original response body is returned. Every original frame must be
consumed, including header errors and command58 partial payload errors. A
command58 payload status6 or10 is not a frame-header error and is not forced
through whole-owner rollback.

## Complete owner endpoints and117

Sum32 exports complete before and after owners for every actual frame.
Each after(N) must match before(N+1) in pointer, length, and whole-byte digest.
Memory reads between commands therefore use a real exported committed state;
the old R4 limitation about unexported intermediate owners is not silently
removed. It is replaced by a stronger, explicit input requirement.

Every full compressed owner is checked for its own complete single XZ stream,
uncompressed length and SHA, original compressed length/SHA/mode, and original
journal reference. Both decoded snapshots run the original owner predicates.
The original frame-boundary method is called on the original command, response,
and complete endpoint bytes. Its full_general_transition claim remains false.
The unsupported isolated ViewInfo transition checker is neither called nor
bypassed to claim broader transition qualification.

For117, the original source03 owner method receives before_raw and after_raw.
It proves the real AccumulateGrad target and incarnation, then inverts only
the validated descriptor192/200 words and public T-row publication fields.
The entire descriptor Hold and entire owner must then match. No descriptor
page, allocator table, Tensor Storage, RNG region, or remaining Hold is omitted.

The entire regenerated owner-frames.jsonl must equal the original bytes.
The original Case and original top report must match in every field, followed
by a whole original top-report byte comparison. No identity field, warning,
failure payload, source field, owner digest, or observation is projected out.

## Archive and input custody

file-manifest.json uses schema
heptatorch.sum-native32.complete-raw-members.v1. It is outside complete.tar.xz.
The archive uses one XZ stream and regular USTAR files/directories only.
All file lengths, SHA256 values, modes, and exact member sets are checked.
The full decompressed TAR hash is checked, and all bytes after the first TAR
end marker must be zero padding. Symlinks, hardlinks, sparse members, hidden
members after TAR EOF, and concatenated XZ streams are rejected.

All native-run directory modes are original. Input, execution-receipt, and
pure-source container directories are explicitly synthetic0700 containers;
this does not change any member file's original mode. Every native checked
input is an exact archive member, linked by original absolute path and full
record. The working originals are also independently compared against all

def __init__(self, directory, report, session, owner_module):
        self.directory, self.report = Path(directory), report
        self.session, self.module = session, owner_module
        self.blobs = report["complete_frame_owner_blobs"]
        same(session.transport["owner_blobs"], self.blobs,
             "transport-and-case-complete-owner-blob-ledger")
        raw = read(self.directory / "owner-frames.jsonl")
        need(raw.endswith(b"\n") and raw, "complete-nonempty-owner-journal-EOF")
        lines = raw.splitlines()
        need(all(lines), "no-empty-owner-journal-record")
        self.journal = [json.loads(line) for line in lines]
        need(len(self.journal) == report["complete_frame_count"] == len(session.requests),
             "one-original-complete-owner-pair-per-frame")
        self.cache, self.capture_cursor = OrderedDict(), 0
        self.seen_digests, self.current_reads = set(), 0
        self.captured_endpoints = 0
        self.frame_refusals, self.partial_payload_errors = 0, 0
        self.rollback_bytes = 0
        referenced = set()
        previous = None
        for index, row in enumerate(self.journal, 1):
            need(set(row) == {"frame", "request_sha256", "request_bytes", "commands", "before",
                 "response_sha256", "response_bytes", "after", "frame_status", "record_count", "checks"},
                 "complete-successful-observer-journal-fields", frame=index)
            request, response = session.requests[index-1], session.responses[index-1]
            status, records, commands = session.decoded[index-1]
            need(row["frame"] == index and row["request_sha256"] == SHA(request)
                 and row["request_bytes"] == len(request) and row["response_sha256"] == SHA(response)
                 and row["response_bytes"] == len(response), "raw-wire-journal-binding", frame=index)
            same(row["commands"], [list(command) for command in commands],
                 "exact-journal-command-words")
            need(row["frame_status"] == status and row["record_count"] == len(records),
                 "actual-wire-header-status-and-record-count", frame=index)
            for label, frame in (("before", index-1), ("after", index)):
                ref = row[label]
                need(set(ref) == {"label", "frame", "pointer", "length", "sha256", "verified_summary"},
                     "complete-original-endpoint-fields", frame=index, phase=label)
                need(ref["label"] == label and ref["frame"] == frame
                     and type(ref["pointer"]) is int and ref["pointer"] >= 0
                     and type(ref["length"]) is int and 0 <= ref["length"] <= 64*(1 << 20)
                     and (ref["pointer"] == 0) == (ref["length"] == 0),
                     "exact-endpoint-state-and-length", frame=index, phase=label)
                need(ref["sha256"] in self.blobs, "declared-complete-endpoint-blob")
                entry = self.blobs[ref["sha256"]]
                need(set(entry) == {"path", "bytes", "sha256", "compressed_bytes", "compressed_sha256", "mode"}
                     and entry["sha256"] == ref["sha256"] and entry["bytes"] == ref["length"]
                     and entry["path"] == "complete-owner/"+ref["sha256"]+".bin.xz",
                     "whole-owner-ledger-and-canonical-name")
                referenced.add(ref["sha256"])
            if previous is not None:
                need(all(previous[key] == row["before"][key]
                         for key in ("pointer", "length", "sha256")),
                     "after-N-equals-before-N-plus-one-complete-owner", frame=index)
                # SHA binding is independently checked against the complete bytes
                # when every capture is consumed; neither endpoint is synthesized.
            previous = row["after"]
            if status:
                need(all(row["before"][key] == row["after"][key]
                         for key in ("pointer", "length", "sha256")),
                     "original-header-error-whole-owner-rollback", frame=index)
                self.frame_refusals += 1
                self.rollback_bytes += row["before"]["length"]

                if record["opcode"] == 58 and record["value"] != 0:
                    need(status == 0, "partial-backward-payload-is-not-a-frame-error", frame=index)
                    self.partial_payload_errors += 1

        need(report["full_transition_recomputed"] is False,
